title: feat(app-showcase): restore page:card panels on My Work
body:
Companion to objectui [#1815](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/1815) (which fixed `page:card`-in-region — the thin layout div was shadowing the real renderer).

Restores the My Work sidebar to use `page:card`:
- a **Shortcuts** card (title + children list)
- an **admin-only Leadership** card gated by `visible: "user.email == 'admin@objectos.ai'"`

Both render title + body, and the role gate hides for non-matching users. Browser-verified on `:5181`. 20 showcase tests pass.
